reason: I already take Toplux and just reorder it when it runs out, so I'm not shopping for a new one. And honestly I forget my vitamins half the time, so another box would just sit on the counter.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put 8 forms in one capsule? I'd be paying more to switch to something that looks narrower than what I already take.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, simple reason why bisglycinate alone beats a multi-form blend, plus a price near what I already pay for my current one.
